title: Invitation slip
summary: With no games the slip turns into an invitation: 'Vaše statistiky začnou dnes', one line of explanation, the four things it will track with muted dash values and dot leaders, and a red full-width 'Začít hrát · dnešní tabule' row (the receipt's total row) that scrolls to the board and focuses the input.
tradeoffs: Shows dashes instead of numbers, so the slip still looks like a list of blanks; adds one more red call to action on the page.
